text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
That was amazing, Trainer! Are you sure
you want
to give them to me?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Thank you! I'll treasure your gift forever!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Aw, we're like carrots in a planter
already. You're
gonna love my roommate
Ardan!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Let's all do our best together from
now on!
